notes: Portable public-API translation of the verified 27-assertion native NRG-enabled sole-regulator disable witness. The adapter supplies a complete FOM with the standard nonRegulatedGrant switch enabled, endpoint, logical-time implementation and callback model. A constrained receiver's strict TAR at the defined GALT boundary remains pending while the sole regulator is active. Disable Time Regulation makes that regulator cease to bound the advance; the receiver then obtains one Time Advance Grant at the requested time. This is distinct from the regulator-resignation case; resignation here occurs only after the observed grant as fixture cleanup. Direct native mappings are page-188-l87-26 to IEEE 1516.1-2025 clause 8.2, page-189-l162-44 to clause 8.3.1, page-194-l21-3 and page-194-l69-19 to clause 8.8.3, and sections-semantic-clause-4b-page-067-l50-4 to IEEE 1516.2-2025 clause 4.13.3. Other native setup mappings and a general NRG scheduling proof are not claimed. Official-header C++ primary and contract passed twice in evoked and immediate models against installed package libraries. Java parity compiles against the official API-only JAR; provider runtime is unverified.
